headline: Bitcoin drops below $60,000 for first time since July on Fed rate expectations
summary: Bitcoin fell below $60,000 for the first time since July, pressured by a stronger US dollar and growing market expectations that the Federal Reserve could raise interest rates further.
why: Bitcoin is the world's largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization and serves as a primary barometer for liquidity and risk appetite.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Expectations of prolonged high interest rates squeezed demand for high-risk digital assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Macroeconomic tightening expectations prompted liquidations in speculative digital token markets.
